newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.3 percent in the week ended February 22 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.0 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 2.0 percent from the prior month.

"Sales were generally on plan for most retailers," the report said. "Some retailers continued to echo the fact that sales on the West Coast -- and in California in particular -- led the national sales pace."
